title: Towards Efficient Auto-Interpretability of Boltz-1 Sparse Autoencoders
abstract: arXiv:2608.27754v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) could turn AI models in Biology and other fields into engines of scientific discovery by explaining the superhuman capabilities of those models. We postulate that a latent is useful if we know three things: whether it is coherent, whether it can be described, and whether that description has predictive power. These questions are routinely conflated. We assemble them into a single pipeline and report some practical innovations. First, cross-seed dictionary stability prioritises which latents are worth spending resources to investigate. Second, an intruder-detection task asks whether a latent's activating examples share a recognizable pattern. Third, a separate pass proposes a candidate biological description which we convert into falsifiable predictions which can be tested in silico. Deployed on the Boltz-1 Pairformer trunk, stability prioritisation finds interpretable latents using about 4.4 times few

translated_title: 迈向Boltz-1稀疏自编码器的高效自动可解释性研究
translated_abstract: 稀疏自编码器（SAE）可以通过解释生物学及其他领域AI模型的超人能力，将这些模型转化为科学发现的引擎。我们提出，一个潜在特征是否有用取决于三个问题的答案：它是否连贯一致、它是否可以被描述、以及该描述是否具有预测能力。这些问题在以往研究中经常被混为一谈。我们将它们整合成一个统一的流水线，并报告了若干实用创新。首先，跨种子字典稳定性用于优先确定哪些潜在特征值得投入资源进行研究。其次，入侵者检测任务用于检验潜在特征的激活样本是否共享可识别的模式。第三，通过一个独立步骤提出候选的生物学描述，并将其转化为可在计算机上（in silico）测试的可证伪预测。将该系统部署于Boltz-1的Pairformer主干上后，稳定性优先化机制能够以约少4.4倍（的资源）找到可解释的潜在特征。
tldr: 该论文提出了一套针对Boltz-1稀疏自编码器的自动化可解释性流水线，通过跨种子字典稳定性优先排序、入侵者检测任务和可证伪的计算机预测测试三项创新，实现了对潜在特征的高效自动解释与筛选。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an efficient automated interpretability pipeline for Boltz-1 sparse autoencoders, featuring three innovations—cross-seed dictionary stability prioritization, intruder-detection tasks, and falsifiable in-silico predictions—to automatically identify and describe useful latents.
